title: Lakebase support for compliance security profile standards
body: Lakebase is now available by default for workspaces with the [compliance security profile](/aws/en/security/privacy/security-profile) enabled and either HIPAA, C5, or TISAX controls selected, and for workspaces with the compliance security profile enabled without a compliance standard. See [Data protection](/aws/en/oltp/projects/data-protection).
